 By Sabrina Castro October 18, 2026 at 11:19 pm EDT Enter Fullscreen Expand WSB-TV Georgia Lottery studios By Sabrina Castro October 18, 2026 at 11:19 pm EDT EVANS, Ga. — A Georgia Lottery player won a $125,000 jackpot in the Oct. 15 Fantasy 5 drawing with a ticket purchased in Evans.
 [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 The winning ticket was sold at Publix at 5119 Washington Road. It matched all five winning numbers: 04, 07, 17, 27 and 38.
 Fantasy 5 drawings are held daily, and jackpots start at $125,000.
 Proceeds from the Georgia Lottery benefit education programs in the state, including the HOPE Scholarship Program and Georgia’s Pre-K Program.
